title: Preserve six input roles in Windows selected-output comparisons
body:
PR2101's complete selected-output comparator rejects a correctly bound native Windows receipt at its POSIX-root validator. This opt-in adapter authenticates the six exact native input-role keys and their same-side hashes, translates only those keys, and delegates all 105 outputs to the unchanged source-pinned comparator. Literal path-like strings elsewhere and the original invoice/log/timing checks stay covered.

The bounded interface accepts canonical POSIX and ordinary absolute Windows drive roots. It rejects ambiguous spelling and case-colliding roles; UNC/device/extended-length paths remain unsupported. No supplier code or selected frontier is modified. The package is `research/selected-windows-role-adapter/` only.

Validation on native Windows / CPython3.12.11: metadata/source pins passed; registered normal and optimized replays both passed **6 positive and 176 negative controls** (63.81seconds total). Controls include all fifteen role swaps, six-role key/digest failures, all105 output omissions, unsupported roots, a real six-key/five-casefold-identity collision, scientific/raw-link changes and immutable predecessor corruption. A separate Codex review verified all five vendor files against PR2101's exact commit and found a test-coverage gap, fixed before final replay. No independent human or hosted-CI pass is claimed.

Base current canonical main `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, priorityrevision4. Refreshed before submission; final overlap covered552 open PRs and1063 Discussion records with complete pagination/no warnings. Claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1472#discussioncomment-18941855 . The original Windows supplier handoff was already claimed in #2333, so this scoped complementary comparator work avoids duplicating it.

**Limit:** these are constructed path relocations of authenticated reviewed outputs, not a fresh supplier run. Concurrent #2336 reports a native Windows successor replay and CRLF-only inner logs. This adapter retains PR2101's byte-exact log policy; it does not claim to admit that complete Windows run. A separately reviewed log policy/composed caller remains open, as do cold ancestry and all inherited mathematical obligations. No new kappa.

Credit Adam Gall (#2101 at `a247ef876e50bf3a7d890c7c1f9b409576674d7d`, #2059), commdata2338 (#2040), Josie Elliston (#1824), josecarlosgonzalezroque-design (#2316), Maxime Fleury/Antoine Olivier, and Rohan Arun, Jeremy Kothe, Hao Yan, Douglas Colkitt and retained supplier lineage. Predecessor files/notices are unchanged. Prepared for AAAmirinu with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in design, implementation, tests and writing. Apache-2.0; no merge, closure or frontier change requested.

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-windows-role-adapter
```
